And it came to pass, while they were slaying them, and I was left, that I fell upon my face, and cried, and said,
This declares that the servants of God have a compassion when they see his judgments executed. Ah Lord GOD! wilt thou destroy the whole remnant of Israel in thy pouring out of thy fury upon Jerusalem?
As touching me also, mine eye shall not spare them, neither will I haue pitie, but will recompence their wayes vpon their heades.
And beholde, the man clothed with linen which had the ynkhorne by his side, made report, and saide, Lorde, I haue done as thou hast commanded me.
